info.title: InQuote Staff API
info.description: InQuote Backend MVP: staff authentication/account management, common data, owned drafts, immutable publication, viewing access and anonymous snapshot retrieval. Frontends and production operations remain separate work.

post.description: Exact Admin Origin/JSON. Uniform INVALID_CREDENTIALS for missing/nonexistent/wrong/disabled/expired temporary credentials. Limited sessions allow inspection/change-password/own password receipts/logout only. 10 attempts/email and 30/IP per 15 minutes.

Set-Cookie.description: __Host-inquote_session; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; no Domain.

get.description: Lock/recheck current account/session. 30-minute idle, 8-hour absolute expiry; temporary expiry may be sooner. 300 staff requests/session/minute.

post.description: Repeatable 204 for absent/expired/revoked sessions. Valid sessions require CSRF. Exact Origin/JSON {}. Clears cookie.

Set-Cookie.description: __Host-inquote_session; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; no Domain.

post.description: Full/limited session, exact Origin/CSRF/original staff If-Match/key/epoch. Atomic password/flags/revision update, all sessions revoked, receipt committed. Fresh login required. Lost response: fresh login then original own receipt lookup. Identical original intent replays before stale ETag/current-password checks and preserves fresh session cookie. Different intent returns 409. Never attach a new epoch to an old intent.

Set-Cookie.description: Clears only on new commit; omitted on replay.

get.description: Calling actor committed receipt with captured recovery epoch. Full/limited staff can inspect own password-change receipts. Full Administrators also inspect their own retained Employee, Company and Catalog mutation receipts. Foreign/unsupported receipts are OPERATION_UNKNOWN; no input secrets or historical mutable bodies are returned. Full staff can also recover own CREATE_QUOTATION/SAVE_DRAFT/DISCARD_DRAFT receipts after fresh current ownership check, including retained discard tombstones.

200.description: Own committed result; no input secrets.

get.description: Full Administrator only. EMPLOYEE records, ordered by displayName/id. Signed cursor binds search/enabled/limit and current epoch; authorization is reapplied. No password hashes or temporary credentials.

post.description: Full Administrator/CSRF/epoch/key. Fixed EMPLOYEE role and enabled=true; 24-hour setup credential generated from 32 random bytes by the client. Shared create/reset limit 10 per Administrator/hour. Replays recover the original receipt without returning credentials.

201.description: Committed actor-scoped receipt; temporary credentials are never returned.

get.description: Full Administrator; EMPLOYEE targets only. Returns the scoped ETag in header and body.

200.description: Employee identity, state and setup metadata.

ETag.description: Strong employee ETag bound to the recovery epoch.

put.description: Full Administrator/CSRF/epoch/key/employee If-Match. Update only displayName and enabled; email and role are immutable. Disable atomically revokes every target session; enabling never revives old cookies. Replay is resolved before stale preconditions.

200.description: Committed actor-scoped receipt; temporary credentials are never returned.

post.description: Full Administrator/CSRF/epoch/key/employee If-Match. Hash client-generated canonical 32-byte base64url temporary credential, set mustChangePassword/24-hour expiry and revoke all target sessions atomically. Preserve enabled state. No credential in response/receipt. Shared create/reset limit 10 per Administrator/hour.

200.description: Committed actor-scoped receipt; temporary credentials are never returned.

get.description: Full staff session reads singleton profile id1; optional fields may remain null until quotation sharing.

put.description: Full Administrator/CSRF/epoch/key/original company If-Match. Full replacement of the four allowed fields. Blank nullable text becomes null; published snapshots are unaffected. Identical receipt replay precedes stale preconditions.

200.description: Committed actor-scoped operation receipt; fetch the current resource separately.

get.description: Full staff, signed pagination sorted by name/id. Employee sees active entries only and cannot request active=false. Administrator may filter availability. Authorization is reapplied on every page.

post.description: Full Administrator/CSRF/epoch/key; canonical whole-VND unitPrice string. Returns a receipt; subsequent reads expose the authoritative revision.

201.description: Committed actor-scoped operation receipt; fetch the current resource separately.

get.description: Full staff; inactive entries are unavailable to Employee. Includes sourceRevision for future quotation selection and resource ETag.

put.description: Full Administrator/CSRF/epoch/key/original item If-Match. Full replacement including active availability. Inactivation blocks new selection but does not change copied quotation bases/prices or published snapshots. No delete endpoint.

200.description: Committed actor-scoped operation receipt; fetch the current resource separately.

get.description: SQL ownership and stable updatedAt/id descending pagination. Signed cursor binds filters/limit/epoch; search treats %/_ literally.

post.description: Empty body. Current staff becomes owner; allocate reference and v1 DRAFT atomically with successful receipt. Replay retains original resource even after discard.

get.description: Own or Administrator. Discarded never-shared allocations return generic404.
Numbered internal history, ascending actual allocated version numbers. No content or public token.
Version must belong to authorized quotation. DRAFT adds live company context/readiness; SHARED reads preserved companySnapshot, without public grant or token.

put.description: Full replacement under current DRAFT/version If-Match. Resolve active observed new/refresh sources under ordered locks; retain copied existing bases unless refreshSourceRevision supplied. Canonical exact-string calculation, quote/version revisions, projection and receipt commit together.

delete.description: No request body. Delete only DRAFT; retain counter/history/access and ownership. Hide never-shared quotation via retained tombstone. Same original successful key replays after deletion.

post.description: Read-only over supplied replacement and saved DRAFT/version If-Match. Origin/JSON required; no CSRF/operation key/epoch header. persisted:false; no content, projection or receipt write. Same exact validation/calculation as Save.

Read-only saved catalog line. Origin/JSON and DRAFT/version If-Match, no operation headers/CSRF. Edited quantity/override values produce nullable amounts. Source must remain active and unit unchanged. Apply locally; later Save submits observed refreshSourceRevision.

Return the existing DRAFT before checking stale quotation allocation ETag (200 REUSE_DRAFT receipt); otherwise copy the latest immutable saved values without live catalog/company data, preserve owner, allocate a never-reused number and create a DRAFT (201 CREATE_REVISION receipt). Both outcomes have durable actor receipts; require a well-formed quotation If-Match.

Read-only saved DRAFT review. Require complete fields and recalculate exact saved values; return allowlisted commercial presentation and a ten-minute signature binding actor, quotation/version/company revisions, recovery epoch and presentation hash. No Save, CSRF or operation headers.

Verify the current saved review and freeze snapshot/company, advance latest pointer, overwrite access generation and commit receipt atomically. Receipt replay precedes expired review/stale guards and never extends access. Raw links are retrieved separately.

get.description: Read latest ACTIVE/EXPIRED/REVOKED access metadata and scoped ETag. Older SHARED versions return only SUPERSEDED without usable ETag. DRAFT has no access (404).

With fresh current access If-Match and authorization retrieve only the latest active decrypted fragment URL. Copy neither rotates nor extends access; expired/revoked return LINK_UNAVAILABLE; superseded versions return ACCESS_SUPERSEDED.

post.description: Revoke the latest grant and clear encrypted token material without editing the shared snapshot. Replay preserves the original result.
Overwrite latest generation/hash/authenticated ciphertext with a fresh 720-hour grant, including expired/revoked access. Snapshot stays unchanged; replay cannot extend or resurrect an old generation.

Anonymous allowlisted immutable snapshot. Ignores staff cookies and Origin. Independent 120/IP/minute quota; lookup rechecks hash, latest pointer, revocation and exact database-clock expiry under shared quotation/version/access locks. Invalid parsed DTO/token, unknown, expired, revoked and superseded links all return 404 LINK_UNAVAILABLE without private details; malformed transport JSON can return 400. All responses are no-store.

temporaryPassword.description: Canonical unpadded base64url encoding of 32 cryptographically random bytes; client generated and handed over manually. Never returned by the server.
